_about: A profile is a set of requirements (77 profiles in
data/processed/scenarios/profiles.jsonl). 'gold' is the list of correct licenses: every
in-scope license whose labels meet all the requirements. It is computed from the labels,
not chosen by a person. Here: trademark protected means the license has the
'trademark-use' limitation; document changes not required means it lacks the

requirements: The license must explicitly NOT grant rights to the project's name, logos, or trademarks.
People who modify the code should not be obliged to document or mark what they changed.
